SELECT USER_ID, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, USER_EMAIL, PASSWORD, ROLE_ID, USER_NAME, GENDER, MOBILE1, MOBILE2, MOBILE3, PHONE1, PHONE2, PHONE3, BIRTH, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, USER_REGDATE, ORIGIN_USER, SYS_USER FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, USER_EMAIL, PASSWORD, ROLE_ID, USER_NAME, GENDER, MOBILE1, MOBILE2, MOBILE3, PHONE1, PHONE2, PHONE3, BIRTH, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, USER_REGDATE, ORIGIN_USER, SYS_USER ) VALUES ( USERS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{providerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{password, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roleId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mobile1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mobile2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mobile3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{originUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, USER_EMAIL, ROLE_ID, USER_NAME, GENDER, MOBILE1, MOBILE2, MOBILE3, BIRTH, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, USER_REGDATE, ORIGIN_USER, SYS_USER FROM USERS ORDER BY USER_ID DESC
